headings.usage: Bold, condensed, all-caps headlines for hero statements (like a briefing/ops-center display)

body.usage: Clean sans-serif body text; enterprise/government-grade software feel

layouts.spacing: Generous negative space. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections.
layouts.grid: Bento grid for cards. Asymmetry where possible, but maintain an enterprise feel.
layouts.navigation: Sticky top nav with backdrop blur (Glassmorphism), z-50.

ui_motifs: Glowing dashboard cards with live-looking data (percentages, counters, sparklines)
Bounding-box style annotations (like AI object detection)
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Retro-Futurism / Technical Look. Sharp edges or max 4px radius. 1px borders (border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use inner glows or subtle box-shadows matching the accent color for active elements.

component_instructions.hero: Large kinetic hero, masked line-by-line reveal, one subtle parallax or 3D hero moment.
component_instructions.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, glowing accent on hover. Use Lucide icons.
component_instructions.buttons: Sharp edges, 1px border. Primary button filled with accent color, hover states increase brightness.
component_instructions.toggles: For LGU vs Schools: smooth animation shifting accent color globally from blue to purple.
component_instructions.marquee: One slow editorial marquee with tech keywords or stats.
component_instructions.form: Contact form with transparent/glass inputs, sharp borders. Resend/database wiring required.

motion.reveals: Framer motion scroll reveals (fade up, line-by-line text reveals).
motion.micro_interactions: Animated counters for stats, pulsing dots for 'live' cameras, typing effects for AI chat.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page application with React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
Install @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react for technical iconography.
Implement the sticky navigation with links scrolling to respective sections.
Create a toggle in the Vision Intelligence section that switches content and globally changes the accent CSS variable from blue to purple.
Create dashboard mockups using CSS grids, adding small animated details like blinking recording dots or incrementing counters.
No generic centered layouts. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout flexibility.
Forms must use Shadcn components but styled to match the dark technical theme.
Implement a contact form that saves to the database and emails via Resend (as per user choices).
Follow exact text provided in the prompt for sections.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like sharp tech buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
